scope: Fail-closed detection of a single older, valid, same-context conversion role journal during resume
baselineReproduction: After an unknown signed conversion attempt, replacing only the controller, operator or price-attestation journal with its original empty but valid role-labelled bytes caused prepareTokenConversionRuntime to accept an incomplete three-journal set. The focused expected-rejection test failed on the parent source. No additional signature or send occurred in the test.
correction: Under each journal's exclusive store transaction, verify the full typed row and return compact immutable attempt facts to private bootstrap. Before authentication or custody access, bootstrap requires every signer-role attempt to match a controller message/intent and every controller signed transaction to retain both exact signer-role cached signatures. The public initialize result still exposes only contextHash.

localValidation.focusedBefore: 1 expected-rejection case failed on parent source
localValidation.focusedAfter: 1/1 passed across controller, operator and price-attestation partial-restore controls

limits: This detects a partial rollback among the three files, not an all-three rollback to a mutually consistent older backup.
A production backup must prove no signed attempt after its snapshot or remain recovery-only until complete authenticated chain reconciliation and an explicitly reviewed restart.
Journals are read sequentially while services should be quiesced; a concurrent legitimate write can fail closed and require another review.
Financial RPC, signatures, bank and finality are synthetic. No production service, wallet, chain transaction, funding or Mainnet activation was used.
